name: John Henrik Clarke
summary: John Henrik Clarke (born John Henry Clark; January 1, 1915 – July 16, 1998) was an African-American historian, professor, prominent Afrocentrist, and pioneer of Pan-African and Africana studies and professional institutions in academia starting in the late 1960s.

image.note: The John Henrik Clarke Africana Library at Cornell University; no freely licensed portrait of Clarke is available.
